Goal

To Enhance My UI Skills By Recreating A Real-World App Interface, Focusing On Cleaner Design, Better Usability, And Layout Improvement.

Time Taken

Roughly 4–5 Days — To Carefully Replicate Multiple Screens, Maintain Consistency, And Understand How Design Systems Are Applied In Real Products.

Red Bus ( Redesign )

This RedBus Redesign Was A Personal UI Exercise Project, Wherein I Remade The Current Interface To Hone My Design Skills. Attention Was Paid To Enhancing Structure, Visual Hierarchy, And General Consistency. Although It's A Borrowed Idea, The Exercise Assisted Me In Breaking Down Better Usability Patterns. It Illustrates My Hands-On Learning Style To Actual-World App Interfaces.

What I Learned

By Reconstructing This Actual-World UI, I Honed My Detail Orientation, Refined My Layout Competency, And Learned More About How Professional Apps Preserve Hierarchy, Space, And User Flow Between Multiple Screens.

"Every pixel I recreated brought me a step closer to mastering real-world design execution."
